name: Knott's Calico Saloon & Pretzel Carts Warm Bavarian Soft Pretzel (Plain, No Cheese)
brandOrRestaurant: Calico Saloon & Ghost Town Pretzel Carts (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Warm baked refined white-flour pretzel inside Calico Saloon or at the Ghost Town carts—zero dairy, zero citrus, and easy to snack on while watching the saloon show.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Salted Pretzel (no cheese cup) and brush off excess coarse salt; if ordering Calico Saloon's famous Sarsaparilla, let the fizz settle if carbonation bloats you.
watchOuts: Avoid Boysenberry Punch/Lemonade if cut with lemon juice (citrus trigger)
